## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Explain any checks unavailable or not applicable.

## Review checklist

- [ ] No real student data, private documents, biometric material, or secrets are included.
- [ ] Applicable documentation, contracts, and migrations are updated.
- [ ] Access and data-handling implications are explained, where applicable.
- [ ] Relevant reviewers have been requested; two approvals are required by team policy.

## Deployment or unresolved decisions

Describe migration, rollback, deployment, or stakeholder decisions where applicable.
